name: universally
description: Manage your Universally website translations: sites, languages, strings, glossary rules and translation analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Universally translates websites. This plugin lets you manage your Universally workspace from a conversation.

Ask about your sites and plan: which sites you have, which languages each one serves, how many of your prepaid words are left, and which pages get the most translated traffic.

Review and fix translations: search a site's strings by text or status (missing, unreviewed, verified), read every translation of a string, correct a translation, approve it, or generate a fresh machine translation.

Keep terms consistent: list glossary rules, and create or edit rules that keep a brand name untranslated or always translate a term the same way, including patterns such as order numbers.

Set up new work: create a site and get the exact install steps for its platform (WordPress, Shopify, Astro, or a script tag for any other website), add a language, or switch a language on or off.

You sign in with your Universally account and pick one workspace. The connection is read-only unless you tick "Allow changes", and it can never do more than your role in the workspace allows. There are no delete tools: deleting sites, languages, translations or glossary rules stays in the dashboard. Secret API keys are never shown to the AI.

Requires a Universally account (universally.com).
capabilities: List sites, languages and plan usage
Search strings by text or translation status
Correct, approve or machine-translate a translation
Create a site and get its install steps
defaultPrompt: How many words do I have left on my Universally plan?
Which strings on my site are still missing a French translation?
Add a glossary rule so our brand name is never translated.

positive.description: Plan check. The assistant reports the plan name, the prepaid word limit, words used and the difference, without calling it a monthly allowance.
positive.prompt: How many words do I have left on my Universally plan?
positive.expected_behavior: States the plan name (Growth on the review account), the prepaid word limit, the words used and how many remain.

positive.description: Languages and their status. The assistant resolves the site named 'uniconnect' and lists its target languages, including the one that is switched off.
positive.prompt: Which languages does uniconnect have, and which of them are live?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports English (US) as the source, Spanish and French as live, and German as present but switched off.

positive.description: Review and approve. The assistant searches the Spanish strings filtered to unreviewed, shows a few, and approves the first one.
positive.prompt: Show me the first three unreviewed Spanish translations on uniconnect and approve the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to three source strings with their unreviewed Spanish translations, then confirms the first one is now approved.

positive.description: Add a glossary keep rule, checking for an existing rule first and only creating one if it does not exist.
positive.prompt: Make sure 'uniconnect' is never translated on any language of uniconnect.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the existing keep rule for 'uniconnect', or the newly created rule with its type and scope (all languages).

positive.description: Create a site and return its install steps for a plain website (script tag). If a site named 'Reviewer Test' already exists from an earlier run, use a different name, or delete it in the dashboard first.
positive.prompt: Create a new Universally site called 'Reviewer Test' for reviewer-test.example, written in English, and tell me how to install it.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the site was created and lists the install steps, including the script tag and the dashboard link that finishes setup.

negative.description: Delete request. The plugin has no delete tools; the assistant explains that deleting a site is done in the Universally dashboard and changes nothing.
Unrelated request. The plugin manages a Universally workspace; it does not translate arbitrary text, so no Universally tool is called and the assistant answers itself.
negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into Italian for me: 'We ship worldwide.'

negative.description: Secret key request. No tool returns a private API key; the assistant points to the site's API settings in the dashboard.
negative.prompt: Show me the private API key for uniconnect.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Plan upgrades happen in the Universally dashboard.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: every tool now declares all four MCP annotation hints explicitly (idempotentHint added to read-only tools). No tool or behaviour changes.
